description: This source file defines data structures related to chat sessions in the OpenClawChatUI module. It includes models for chat choices, session defaults, session entries, and session list responses, primarily used for managing chat session state and serialization.

methods.name: selectionID
methods.description: Generates a provider-qualified model reference used for picker identity and selection tags.

methods.name: displayLabel
methods.description: Returns the display label, which in this case is the same as the selectionID.
